_comment: Watchful Holds: an enemy castle or town harasses a lord party that marches close by. Every value is validated at load (NaN, Infinity, range, sign); a bad value reverts to its default with a warning in the TAOM log. Read once per game session: an edit needs a full restart of Bannerlord.
_comment_radius: Map units from the fort inside which its garrison watches the road. Above 0, at most 50.
_comment_minimums: The fewest garrison troops a fort needs to harass, and the fewest men a party needs to be harassed.
_comment_chance: Chance per campaign hour, 0 to 1, for the player's party and for AI lords. The fort owner's culture multiplies it below; the result is clamped to 0..1.
_comment_losses: The player's losses: fraction of the party's men plus a random 0..extra, wounded and killed. Both are capped at the healthy regulars; heroes are never hit. AI lords are only disorganized.
_comment_supplies: Share of the party's food lost, and the morale and army cohesion lost per hit (0 to 100). cohesionFloor: a hit never takes army cohesion below it and never raises a cohesion already under it.
_comment_horn: Hours between two horn blasts for the player.
_comment_cultures: Multipliers by the culture of the fort's OWNER (lowercase culture id). 'default' covers any culture without a row. chanceMultiplier scales the hourly chance; lossMultiplier scales the fraction part of the kill and wound counts, not the random extras. Each 0 to 5.
